name: Largest Files
description: Lists the largest items per library (Movies, TV Shows, Anime, etc). Movies are listed individually; TV and anime episodes are rolled up into per-series totals so a show's full size across all seasons shows as one entry. Includes CSV export.
overview: Find the largest movies and TV/anime series in your library
